DialogWithForm.ssr: The story writes a lower-case autofocus='true' (a @ts-expect-error workaround for React's autoFocus), and the twin passes autofocus="true" the same way. In the DOM it matches; on the server, svelte/server writes every attribute in a spread through attributes(), which writes autofocus, a boolean attribute in Svelte's list, as autofocus="" whatever its value. The rest of the server markup matches.
